entities.summary: Céline Tendobi is a Congolese doctor of obstetrics and gynecology with a specialty in gynaecology and ultrasound. She is known for her work on the human papilloma virus (HPV) and has written extensively on the connection between HPV and cervical cancer in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
